A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have established a complete characterization for the connectivity of consecutive- d digraphs and provided a general method to construct consecutive- d digraphic networks with maximum connectivity.
the consecutive-d digraph has the same connectivity as the de Bruijn graph if d is a prime power and the same as the Kautz graph if d is an integer greater than or equal to 3.
the consecutive-d digraph is the most connected digraph with the same number of vertices and arcs among all de Bruijn, Kautz and Imase-Iroh digraphs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
consecutive-d digraph connectivity is determined by the connectivity of its underlying de Bruijn graph and the connectivity of its vertex set.
consecutive-d digraph connectivity is determined by the number of distinct letters in the alphabet and the number of consecutive occurrences of a letter in the alphabet.
